programme.desc: The monkey Olly Wannabe has fun conversations with famous Flemish people in bed. / Het aapje Olly Wannabe voert in bed leuke gesprekken met Bekende Vlamingen.

programme.desc: Humoristic animation series about the adventures of AKA, Kiro and Konpeki, three ninjas with fabulous super powers that run a parcel service. / Humoristische animatieserie over de avonturen van Aka, Kiro en Konpeki, drie ninjas met fabelachtige superkrachten die een pakketdienst runnen.

programme.title: Karrewiet with VGT / Karrewiet Met VGT
programme.desc: Infomagazine for the youth. Talculated in Flemish Sign Language (VGT). Also available on ketnet.be, via the KetnetVideo app and via Net Missed. / Infomagazine voor de jeugd. Getolkt in Vlaamse Gebarentaal (VGT). Ook beschikbaar op Ketnet.be, via de KetnetVideo-app en via Net gemist.

programme.title: The rules of Floor / De regels van Floor
programme.desc: A 90s party is being organized at the school of Floor. When Jan hears that his big idol is coming to run DJ Mike, he is crazy. He enthusiastically collects his old records and turntable in the hope of being able to turn at the party. To the great shame of Floor. / Op de school van Floor wordt een jaren 90 feest georganiseerd. Wanneer Jan hoort dat zijn grote idool DJ Mike komt draaien, is hij door het dolle heen. Enthousiast verzamelt hij zijn oude platen en draaitafel in de hoop ook op het feest te mogen draaien. Tot grote schaamte van Floor.

programme.title: The rules of Floor / De regels van Floor
programme.desc: Floor has to go to Ellie, an artist and old girlfriend of her mother. Ellie once made a jacket for Floor: the most horrible jacket of all time. And even more horrible: Floor has to put it on! / Floor moet mee naar Ellie, een kunstenares en oude vriendin van haar moeder. Ellie heeft ooit een jas voor Floor gemaakt: de meest afgrijselijke jas aller tijden. En nog afgrijselijker: Floor moet hem aandoen!

programme.title: In other words / Met andere woorden
programme.desc: Whether the Hopper family could win a golden K? Sarah and Thomas know everything about that! / Of de familie Hopper een Gouden K zou kunnen winnen? Daar weten Sarah en Thomas alles van!

programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Pedro wants to turn the brol into an elite school. That's good for his image. To achieve that, he decides that only the 1% smartest children are still taught. The 99% other students no longer receive lessons. They can play colors and play games in the basement. As a result, they become stupid and the 1% smart children become smarter. Soekie is revolting because everyone is entitled to education. But she finds no support among the fellow students. They are happy that they should not take lessons. / Pedro wil van het BROL een eliteschool maken. Dat is goed voor zijn imago. Om dat te bereiken, beslist hij dat enkel de 1% slimste kinderen nog les krijgen. De 99% andere leerlingen krijgen geen les meer. Ze mogen in de kelder kleuren en spelletjes spelen. Ze worden daardoor dommer en de 1% slimme kinderen worden slimmer. Soekie komt in opstand omdat iedereen recht heeft op onderwijs. Maar ze vindt geen steun bij de medeleerlingen. Die zijn blij dat ze geen les moeten volgen.

programme.title: Bernie / Bernie
programme.desc: Funny animation series about the brilliant inventor Bernie who is lost on the bottom of the ocean. With his clumsy and crazy new neighbors, a return to the island is not easy! / Grappige animatiereeks over de geniale uitvinder Bernie die verdwaald is op de bodem van de oceaan. Met zijn onhandige en maffe nieuwe buren wordt een terugkeer naar het eiland alvast niet makkelijk!

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Daria and Arno realize that they are both so different. Daria believes that Arno has an easy life. All he does is chill. Arno believes that Daria is always far too serious. Arno is convinced that Daria can't even chill. Daria takes on the challenge: she will be Arno, but then Arno must be Daria. The two soon discover that it is not nearly that easy to be each other. / Daria en Arno beseffen dat ze allebei zo anders zijn. Daria vindt dat Arno een gemakkelijk leven heeft. Het enige wat hij doet is chillen. Arno vindt dat Daria altijd veel te serieus is. Arno is ervan overtuigd dat Daria niet eens kan chillen. Daria gaat de uitdaging aan: zij zal Arno zijn, maar dan moet Arno Daria zijn. De twee ontdekken al gauw dat het lang niet zo gemakkelijk is om elkaar te zijn.

programme.title: The Athena / The Athena
programme.desc: Nyela Malik has a big wish: designing her own clothing line. And to realize that wish, no better place is conceivable than The Athena, a prominent art academy in London. / Nyela Malik heeft een grote wens: het ontwerpen van een eigen kledinglijn. En om die wens te realiseren is er geen betere plek denkbaar dan The Athena, een vooraanstaande kunstacademie in Londen.

programme.title: 3Hz / 3Hz
programme.desc: After the death of his mom, Felix discovers that his Walkman can do something special. Together with Sammy and Noor, he catches a disturbing conversation about a murder in 1989. / Na de dood van zijn mama ontdekt Felix dat zijn walkman iets bijzonders kan. Samen met Sammy en Noor vangt hij een verontrustend gesprek op over een moord in 1989.

programme.title: Campus 12: Compilation / Campus 12: compilatie
programme.desc: Tough boxer Noah de Smidt sees his twin sister Bo mysteriously disappear. He seems to be the only one who still remembers Bo, but that is not included in Sam; A young DJ who is also in Boksclub Campus B, but is not exactly Noah's best friend. Together the two go looking for the exhausted girl. Their search leads to the theater of the rival Vincke family and the boys can only infiltrate the choir. And that is just the tip of the iceberg ... / Stoere bokser Noah De Smidt ziet zijn tweelingzus Bo op mysterieuze wijze verdwijnen. Hij lijkt de enige te zijn die zich Bo nog herinnert, maar dat is buiten Sam gerekend; een jonge dj die ook in boksclub Campus B vertoeft, maar niet bepaald Noahs beste vriend is. Samen gaan de twee op zoek naar het uitgewiste meisje. Hun zoektocht leidt naar het theater van de rivaliserende familie Vincke en de jongens kunnen niet anders dan het koor te infiltreren. En dat is slechts het topje van de ijsberg...

programme.title: Shaun the sheep / Shaun Het Schaap
programme.desc: Animation series about the smart sheep Shaun, which experiences all kinds of adventures on the farm. / Animatieserie over het slimme schaapje Shaun, dat allerlei avonturen beleeft op de boerderij.

programme.title: Look out / Kijk uit
programme.desc: Electric cars are quiet, fast and ask for a different driving style. But what are the other advantages and disadvantages of these e-vehicles? Discover it in a new episode of Kijk Uit! / Elektrische autos zijn stil, snel en vragen om een andere rijstijl. Maar wat zijn de andere voor- en nadelen van deze e-voertuigen? Ontdek het in een nieuwe aflevering van Kijk Uit!

programme.title: Down the road / Down the road
programme.sub-title: De groep ontdekt Bangkok vanop meer dan 300 meter hoogte
programme.desc: Today the Thai capital awaits: crowds, noise, scents ... there are insanely a lot of impressions on them and that is a bit easier for one than for the other. With a tuktuk they drive through the city, and they look at Bangkok from more than 300 meters altitude. As icing on the cake, there is also something on the menu that they have not yet encountered in Thailand: insects. / Vandaag wacht de Thaise hoofdstad: drukte, lawaai, geuren... Er komen waanzinnig veel indrukken op hen af en dat is voor de ene al wat makkelijker dan voor de andere. Met een tuktuk rijden ze door de stad, en ze bekijken Bangkok vanop meer dan 300 meter hoogte. Als kers op de taart staat er ook iets op het menu dat ze tot hiertoe nog niet zijn tegengekomen in Thailand: insecten.

programme.title: Winwin / WinWin
programme.desc: In this week's complaint, Xavier Taveirne focuses his arrows on counterfeit clothing. You can find it everywhere on the internet, also on popular platforms such as Vinted. That is a platform that allows you to easily buy and sell with your own account used clothing or things. But the Winwin mailbox shows that many people, often without realizing it, have bought counterfeit clothing through this platform. / In de klacht van deze week richt Xavier Taveirne zijn pijlen op namaakkleding. Die vind je op het internet overal, ook op populaire platformen als Vinted. Dat is een platform waarmee je gemakkelijk met een eigen account gebruikte kleding of spullen kan kopen en verkopen. Maar uit de WinWin-mailbox blijkt dat heel wat mensen, vaak zonder het te beseffen, namaakkleding hebben gekocht via dit platform.

programme.title: F.C. The champions / F.C. De Kampioenen
programme.desc: The father of VAT, a rich beer brewer, disrupts a match of the champions. He comes to check how his son's restaurant is going. When VAT falsely claims to have a new girlfriend, PA refuses to leave VAT without having met his daughter-in-law. In the meantime, the presence of PA VAT also conceives great disagreement between Carmen and Xavier ... / De vader van BTW, een rijke bierbrouwer, verstoort een match van de Kampioenen. Hij komt controleren hoe het gaat met het restaurant van zijn zoon. Wanneer BTW valselijk beweert een nieuwe vriendin te hebben, weigert pa BTW te vertrekken zonder zijn schoondochter-in-spe te hebben ontmoet. Ondertussen verwekt de aanwezigheid van pa BTW ook grote onenigheid tussen Carmen en Xavier ...

programme.title: ZEPPOS - The Mercatorpoor / Zeppos - Het Mercatorspoor
programme.desc: On his 18th birthday, Digital Native Benjamin Kurrel inherits the legacy of his missing father Ben Kurrel: a box of very old objects, including a very rare old book. When he pours the antique book to Slien, the girl he has a crush on, he unintentionally sets a chain reaction in motion. An old man who introduces himself as ZepPos is very interested in the book, which once belonged to cartographer Mercator. With the help of the secret messages in Mercator's book, the three increasingly unpleases the mystery, but a merciless opponent tries to stop them. Their dangerous search not only brings them closer to Mercator's secret, but also confronts Benjamin with his origins. / Op zijn 18de verjaardag erft digital native Benjamin Kurrel het nalatenschap van zijn vermiste vader Ben Kurrel: een doos heel oude voorwerpen, waaronder een zeer zeldzaam oud boek. Wanneer hij het antieke boek aan Slien schenkt, het meisje waar hij een oogje op heeft, zet hij onbedoeld een kettingreactie in beweging. Een oude man die zich voorstelt als Zeppos heeft grote interesse in het boek, dat ooit aan cartograaf Mercator heeft toebehoord. Met behulp van de geheime boodschappen in het boek van Mercator ontsluiert het drietal steeds meer van het mysterie maar een ongenadige tegenstander probeert hen te stoppen. Hun gevaarlijke zoektocht brengt hen niet alleen dichter bij het geheim van Mercator, maar confronteert Benjamin ook met zijn afkomst.

programme.title: Loose wild and poultry / Loslopend wild and gevogelte
programme.desc: With Sketches Situal Humor, loose and poultry brings about how women and the men around them struggle through all kinds of funny but recognizable situations. In addition to standing sketches, there are also sections that come back such as Allez Monique, what am I doing now? And white wine. / Loslopend wild and gevogelte brengt met sketches situatiehumor over hoe vrouwen en de mannen rondom hen zich door allerlei grappige, maar herkenbare situaties worstelen. Naast op zichzelf staande sketches zijn er ook rubrieken die terugkomen zoals Allez Monique, Wat doe ik nu? en Wit Wijntje.

programme.title: More people in their thirties / Dertigers
programme.desc: Laura hides when Klaas suddenly pops up on her new work. Ruben becomes a bit insecure when Sander suddenly meets his ex. Sami confronts grandma with her euthanasia plans. Njezin život okrene se naglavačke kada na obali pronađu tijelo njezine sestre koju godinama nije vidjela...

programme.title: Who shits you / Ko te šiša
programme.desc: The humorous Croatian series Ko Šiša follows you Žigmund, owner of an old -fashioned hairdressing salon for gentlemen and goddess, owner of a modern mosque for ladies Kolet, located one across the way, in a square of Zagreb, and are only divided by Taubek. Although the constant struggle for dominance, two salons are accompanied by a survival game, but when the goddess decides to fully modernize and start to haze and the gentleman, the battle will go to the extermination where no one will choose the means. / Humoristična hrvatska serija Ko te šiša prati Žigmunda, vlasnika staromodnog frizerskog salona Salon za gospodu i Božicu, vlasnicu modernog salona za dame Kolet, koji se nalaze jedan prekoputa, na jednom zagrebačkom trgu, a dijeli ih samo kafanica Pri Taubeku. Iako stalnoj borbi za prevlast, dva salona prate igru preživljavanja, no kada Božica odluči da se potpuno modernizuje i počne da šiša i gospodu, kreće bitka do istrebljenja u kojoj niko neće birati sredstva.

programme.title: ATV news / ATV vijesti
programme.desc: Overview of the most important news in one place, every working day in the most viewed alternative television show _ central news exactly at 19:00 live from the studio. The news brings an overview of events in the Republika Srpska, BiH, region and the world. Guests in the studio comment on the current topics of the day. Journalists The ATV news editorial is investigated, reveal and report on current events and phenomena in the sphere of politics, economy, society, social problems, city curriculum, sports and time. / Pregled najvažnijih vijesti na jednom mjestu, svakog radnog dana u najgledanijoj emisiji Alternativne televizije _ Centralne vijesti tačno u 19:00 uživo iz studija. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

U isto vrijeme lokalni policajac euforično organizuje doček predsjednika države, a njegovi "strogo kontrolisani" građani, pod utiskom dramatičnih događaja oko Kube 1962. godine, počinju se dijeliti na dva tabora, riješena da istjeraju do kraja ono što neće uspjeti Hruščov i Kennedy...

programme.title: Another chance / Druga šansa
programme.desc: Documentary film The second chance of 2024. in the directed by Vajašlav, the story of Ukrainian armed forces, who submitted their weapons and began fighting against the regime in Kiev as part of the Maxi Krivonos. In the hope of the end of the war, everyone has expressed regret and decided to stay aside Russia _ this act is released by anti-Serbian propaganda and begin to reconsider their beliefs. / Dokumentarni film Druga šansa iz 2024. godine u režiji Vjačeslava Guza, priča o vojnicima ukrajinskih oružanih snaga, koji su predali svoje oružje i počeli da se bore protiv režima u Kijevu kao dio jedinice Maksima Krivonosa. U nadi za okončanje rata, svi su izrazili žaljenje i odlučili da stanu na stranu Rusije _ ovim činom se oslobađaju antiruske propagande i počinju da preispituju svoja uvjerenja.

This and such a country speaks a new series of the BHT1 Information Program, "My Land", which edits and, driving its Oldtimer from the end to the end of the Wonderful Bosnia and Herzegovina, leads Elvir Bucalo. / Emisija posvećena Bosni i Hercegovini i nama u njoj, ljudima, životima, sudbinama, onome što ljudi žive, što bi htjeli popraviti, ukazati ili sačuvati za neke nove generacije. Zemlja nije (samo) prostor, nisu samo planine, rijeke, doline, zemlja su, prije svega, ljudi. Zemlju ne čine zastave, politički pamfleti, zemlju čine obični ljudi sa svakodnevnim životima, radostima i tugama... O toj i takvoj zemlji govori novi serijal Informativnog programa BHT1, "Moja zemlja", koji uređuje i, vozeći svoj oldtimer obilazi s kraja na kraj čudesne Bosne i Hercegovine, vodi Elvir Bucalo.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Крег Дугъл Маклалън е в ролята на доктор Лусиен Блейк, който се завръща в Баларат, северозападно от Мелбърн, в края на 1950-те години, за да поеме общата медицинска практика на покойния си баща и ролята на полицейски хирург след отсъствие от 30 години. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. Всеки епизод е около час – между 56 и 59 минути.

programme.title: Football: World Cup qualifiers 2026: 5 round: Lithuania - Malta / Футбол: Квалификации за Световно първенство 2026: 5 кръг: Литва - Малта
programme.desc: National teams from different continents compete in groups and playoffs to win a place among the best to fight for the world title. The qualifications are divided into Confederations - Europe (UEFA), South America (CONMEBOL), Asia (AFC), Africa (Kaf), North and Central America (Konkacaf) and Oceania (OFK). Each region has its own format, with matches being held for several years. / Националните отбори от различни континенти се състезават в групи и плейофи, за да спечелят място сред най-добрите, които ще се борят за световната титла. Квалификациите са разделени по конфедерации – Европа (УЕФА), Южна Америка (КОНМЕБОЛ), Азия (АФК), Африка (КАФ), Северна и Централна Америка (КОНКАКАФ) и Океания (ОФК). The best friends of Cacau are Pitty and Guto who help her make the idea that Brazil tasted the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. programme.title: In battle! / U boj!
programme.desc: In battle! - (Educational program, Croatia, 2016) There are many bright moments in the centuries -old struggle of the Croatian people against different enemies. One of these is the heroic death of the Croatian prince Nikola Zrinski and the small troops of his fighters for the Turkish siege of the Hungarian city of Siget. When the last stronghold of the veterans was on fire after a month after a month, Zrinski, with the remaining soldiers on September 7, 1566. In the last color, almost everyone died, led by Nikola Zrinski. One of the greatest Turkish rulers, Sultan Suleiman II, did not welcome victory. He died two days before, and the great vizier Mehmed-pasha Sokolovic had to cover up his death so he would not discourage the Turkish army ahead of the attack. In Croatian history and the folk tradition of Nikola Zrinski, he remained remembered as one of the greatest heroes who sacrificed their lives for the survival of the homeland, and became the motive of numerous works of art. This documentary was made on the occasion of the 450th anniversary of the event at Siget. R .: Aldo Tardozzi ... / U boj! - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2016) U vjekovnoj borbi hrvatskog naroda protiv različitih neprijatelja ima mnogo svijetlih trenutaka. Jedan od takvih je i junačka pogibija hrvatskog kneza Nikole Zrinskog i male čete njegovih boraca za turske opsade ugarskog grada Sigeta. Kad se poslije mjesec dana opsade posljednje uporište branitelja našlo u plamenu, Zrinski je s preostalim vojnicima 7. rujna 1566. izveo junački juriš iz tvrđave. U zadnjem boju gotovo svi su izginuli na čelu s Nikolom Zrinskim. Jedan od najvećih turskih vladara, sultan Sulejman II., nije dočekao pobjedu. Umro je dva dana prije, a veliki vezir Mehmed-paša Sokolović morao je prikriti njegovu smrt kako ne bi obeshrabrio tursku vojsku uoči napada. U hrvatskoj povijesti i narodnoj tradiciji Nikola Zrinski ostao je upamćen kao jedan od najvećih junaka koji su žrtvovali svoj život za opstanak domovine, te postao motiv brojnih umjetničkih djela. Ovaj dokumentarni film snimljen je u povodu 450. obljetnice događaja kod Sigeta. R.: Aldo Tardozzi...

programme.title: Mountains / Planine
programme.desc: Mountains - (S02, E05, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) We climb the unavoidable Vidova Gora, the highest peak of our islands 780 meters above sea level, then discover the secrets of the dragons of the cave and the Blaca desert - the miraculous residence of Glagolitic. According to the Brac hiking trails, we are led by a handball player, a national team player, the winner of the Olympic gold - Pero Metlicic. Originally from Split, where his parents live today, Pero always returned to Brac. Wherever he traveled, played and lived, Brac was his anchorage. With the "Mountain" team, Pero reveals the island that has neglected a bit during his successful career. His guides are Bracani who know Brac well - with Rank Dragicevic, a Brac mountaineer who passed Vi Adriatica and was on the Himalayas, climbs from Bol to Vidova up and from Blaca Bay to Blaca. With Zoran Kojdić from Murvica, he goes to the dragon's cave, and is led by the keeper of the monastery by Luka Vranjičić. R .: Maja Tokić ... / Planine - (S02, E05, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Penjemo se na nezaobilaznu Vidovu goru, najviši vrh naših otoka 780 metara nadmorske visine, potom otkrivamo tajne Zmajeve pećine i pustinje Blaca - čudesnog prebivališta glagoljaša. Po bračkim planinarskim stazama vodi nas rukometaš, reprezentativac, osvajač olimpijskog zlata - Pero Metličić. Porijeklom iz Splitske, gdje danas žive njegovi roditelji, Pero se uvijek vraćao Braču. Gdjegod putovao, igrao i živio, Brač je bio njegovo sidrište. S ekipom "Planina" Pero otkriva otok koji je pomalo zapostavio tijekom svoje uspješne karijere. Njegovi su vodiči Bračani koji baš dobro poznaju Brač - s Rankom Dragičevićem, bračkim planinarom koji je prošao Viu Adriaticu i bio na Himalaji, penje se iz Bola do Vidove gore te iz uvale Blaca do pustinje Blaca. Sa Zoranom Kojdićem iz Murvica odlazi do Zmajeve pećine, a pustinjom Blaca vodi ga čuvar samostana Luka Vranjičić. R.: Maja Tokić...

programme.title: The bride's team / Mladenkina ekipa
programme.desc: And Vintage Bride - (Romant. Film, Canada, 2022) Valuable tailor Hannah McKenzie works in a renowned Millingtons wedding dress salon and a custom wedding dress. But her additional job was called into question when Will Millington, a successor to the business empire, appeared, who wants to refresh the company's image. programme.title: Mountains / Planine
programme.desc: Mountains - (S02, E05, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) We climb the unavoidable Vidova Gora, the highest peak of our islands 780 meters above sea level, then discover the secrets of the dragons of the cave and the Blaca desert - the miraculous residence of Glagolitic. Originally from Split, where his parents live today, Pero always returned to Brac. Wherever he traveled, played and lived, Brac was his anchorage. With the "Mountain" team, Pero reveals the island that has neglected a bit during his successful career. His guides are Bracani who know Brac well - with Rank Dragicevic, a Brac mountaineer who passed Vi Adriatica and was on the Himalayas, climbs from Bol to Vidova up and from Blaca Bay to Blaca. R .: Maja Tokić ... / Planine - (S02, E05, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Penjemo se na nezaobilaznu Vidovu goru, najviši vrh naših otoka 780 metara nadmorske visine, potom otkrivamo tajne Zmajeve pećine i pustinje Blaca - čudesnog prebivališta glagoljaša. Po bračkim planinarskim stazama vodi nas rukometaš, reprezentativac, osvajač olimpijskog zlata - Pero Metličić. Porijeklom iz Splitske, gdje danas žive njegovi roditelji, Pero se uvijek vraćao Braču. Njegovi su vodiči Bračani koji baš dobro poznaju Brač - s Rankom Dragičevićem, bračkim planinarom koji je prošao Viu Adriaticu i bio na Himalaji, penje se iz Bola do Vidove gore te iz uvale Blaca do pustinje Blaca. Sa Zoranom Kojdićem iz Murvica odlazi do Zmajeve pećine, a pustinjom Blaca vodi ga čuvar samostana Luka Vranjičić. R.: Maja Tokić...

programme.title: In battle! / U boj!
programme.desc: In battle! - (Educational program, Croatia, 2016) There are many bright moments in the centuries -old struggle of the Croatian people against different enemies. One of these is the heroic death of the Croatian prince Nikola Zrinski and the small troops of his fighters for the Turkish siege of the Hungarian city of Siget. When the last stronghold of the veterans was on fire after a month after a month, Zrinski, with the remaining soldiers on September 7, 1566. In the last color, almost everyone died, led by Nikola Zrinski. One of the greatest Turkish rulers, Sultan Suleiman II, did not welcome victory. He died two days before, and the great vizier Mehmed-pasha Sokolovic had to cover up his death so he would not discourage the Turkish army ahead of the attack. In Croatian history and the folk tradition of Nikola Zrinski, he remained remembered as one of the greatest heroes who sacrificed their lives for the survival of the homeland, and became the motive of numerous works of art. This documentary was made on the occasion of the 450th anniversary of the event at Siget. R .: Aldo Tardozzi ... / U boj! - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2016) U vjekovnoj borbi hrvatskog naroda protiv različitih neprijatelja ima mnogo svijetlih trenutaka. Jedan od takvih je i junačka pogibija hrvatskog kneza Nikole Zrinskog i male čete njegovih boraca za turske opsade ugarskog grada Sigeta. Kad se poslije mjesec dana opsade posljednje uporište branitelja našlo u plamenu, Zrinski je s preostalim vojnicima 7. rujna 1566. izveo junački juriš iz tvrđave. U zadnjem boju gotovo svi su izginuli na čelu s Nikolom Zrinskim. Jedan od najvećih turskih vladara, sultan Sulejman II., nije dočekao pobjedu. Umro je dva dana prije, a veliki vezir Mehmed-paša Sokolović morao je prikriti njegovu smrt kako ne bi obeshrabrio tursku vojsku uoči napada. U hrvatskoj povijesti i narodnoj tradiciji Nikola Zrinski ostao je upamćen kao jedan od najvećih junaka koji su žrtvovali svoj život za opstanak domovine, te postao motiv brojnih umjetničkih djela. Ovaj dokumentarni film snimljen je u povodu 450. obljetnice događaja kod Sigeta. R.: Aldo Tardozzi...

Naivna mlada aristokratkinja Alice De Jeansin, koju spašava hrabri radnik, otkriva gorku istinu o svom društvenom statusu. Njezina sluškinja Rose, koja se uskoro trebala otisnuti u avanturu života, umjesto toga biva unakažena i nude joj neobičnu pogodbu. A za Aliceinu tetu, prekrasnu Adrienne, požar je možda prilika koju je čekala - prilika da nestane i krene ispočetka. We are talking about the differences of alcohol consumption in the European north and south. It is drunk up once a week, expensive and much. It is cheaper in the south, it is drunk every day, but a little. Finci earnings more than 3 billion euros per year on video game export, and are the most liberal in the workplace. Pratili smo i radni dan konobara Lorenza i promatrali njegov stil, pravi talijanski koji je u pokretima, u gestama, u pogledu koji sve vidi, ništa ne zaboravlja. Govorimo o razlikama konzumiranja alkohola na europskom sjeveru i na jugu. Gore se pije jednom tjedno, skupo i mnogo. Na jugu je jeftinije, pije se svaki dan, ali pomalo. programme.title: Duel of the earth / Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: DULUM Earth - (S03, E06, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) Diana Prpić Šeketa from Brežan near Karlovac is a young farmer who successfully balances business and private life. Through the episode, viewers follow Diana run the ecological economy, growing strawberries, batatas and other crops, while in parallel cares for her little daughter Cviti and wife Anđelka. In addition to business challenges, Diana also faces motherhood - in the middle of the episode of Raja Rok, which gives her life a new dynamics. In addition to her husband, Anđelka, who helps her jugging her business obligations and family life, Diana successfully leads her agriculture, develops innovative practices such as the use of mycorized Batata transplants and promotes organic agriculture through social networks. The episode explores Diana's dedication to sustainability, the challenges he faces as a young farmer and her influence on the domestic market and the wider community. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Dulum zemlje - (S03, E06, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Diana Prpić Šeketa iz Brežana pokraj Karlovca mlada je poljoprivrednica koja uspješno balansira poslovni i privatni život. Kroz epizodu gledatelji prate kako Diana vodi ekološko gospodarstvo, uzgajajući jagode, batate i druge usjeve, dok paralelno brine o svojoj maloj kćeri Cviti i suprugu Anđelku. Osim poslovnih izazova, Diana se suočava i s majčinstvom - u sredini epizode rađa sina Roka, čime njezin život dobiva novu dinamiku. Uz supruga Anđelka, koji joj pomaže žonglirati poslovne obveze i obiteljski život, Diana uspješno vodi svoju poljoprivredu, razvija inovativne prakse poput korištenja mikoriziranih presadnica batata te putem društvenih mreža promovira ekološku poljoprivredu. Epizoda istražuje Dianinu posvećenost održivosti, izazove s kojima se suočava kao mlada poljoprivrednica te njezin utjecaj na domaće tržište i širu zajednicu. R.: Filip Filković...

Upravo na koncertima popularnih Psihića, publika može na najbolji način vidjeti i osjetiti da rocknroll nije samo glazba nego i stil života, a Gobac se svaki put iznova potvrđuje kao jedan od ponajboljih frontmena na domaćoj sceni i šire. Velikim koncertom na zagrebačkoj Šalati 2018. obilježili su 30 godina od izlaska prvijenca "Godina zmaja" i 35 godina glazbenog stvaralaštva i pokazali nam da i nakon toliko godina vladaju pozornicom kao i na svojim počecima. Njihov 11. studijski album "Digitalno nebo" ovjenčan je nagradom Porin za Najbolji album rock-glazbe, a spot za istoimeni singl, u režiji Ratka Jovanova Gonza, osvojio je Porin za Najbolji videobroj...

programme.title: South America Simon Reeve / Južna Amerika sa Simonom Reeveom
programme.desc: Simon Reeves South America - (E04, Nature. Film, England, 2022) Simon Reeve travels through three most extreme landscapes on Earth: salty plains in Bolivia, Brazilian Panthanal and Chaco Forest in Paraguay. In Bolivia, Simon meets with a family who lives on the collection of salt on the vast expanse of salty plains Uyuni, who are so huge that they are allegedly visible from the moon. They will find out that there may be huge lithium deposits under the salt, a metal that is key to making batteries, especially those for a new generation of electric cars. Crossing in Brazil, Simon visits one of the biggest swamps - Pantanal and will experience a close encounter with Jaguar, the greatest predator in South America. Dries and fires threaten to panthanale, but there are a large threat and excessive flood. Simon will talk to a farmer who spent years building dams to stop water torrents and protect the family farm. During the last stage of this trip, Simon goes to the rarely visited Paraguay, in which he will find a unique community, which, despite being a small, has a great impact on the economy and ecology of this country. Menonites originally come from Europe, but they have moved around the world. Paraguay lives a particularly conservative branch that has renounced all the flow of modern times. They drive the cars with horses and speak their language known as the lower German. Simon will visit a school where children learn biblical texts in traditional costumes, and there is no smartphone in sight. However, menonites are very successful farmers and accept modern growing methods when needed and established spacious farms for cattle and soybeans. They intersected the vast expanses of the unique dry forest of Chaco, which extends in the area of ​​two Spanish and dominates the mid -South American continent. This economic miracle raised Paraguay to the very top of the world's food producers, but maybe that inevitably had its price. Simon concludes this stage of travel by a visit to the Ayoreo people. R.: ... / Simon Reeves South America - (E04, prirod. film, Engleska, 2022) Simon Reeve putuje kroz tri najekstremnija krajolika na Zemlji: slane ravnice u Boliviji, brazilski Pantanal i šumu Chaco u Paragvaju. U Boliviji Simon se susreće s obitelji koja živi od skupljanja soli na golemom prostranstvu slanih ravnica Uyuni koje su tako goleme da su navodno vidljive i s Mjeseca. Saznat će da se ispod soli možda kriju goleme naslage litija, metala koji je ključan za izradu baterija, osobito onih za novu generaciju električnih automobila. Prešavši u Brazil, Simon posjećuje jednu od najvećih močvara - Pantanal te će doživjeti bliski susret s jaguarom, najvećim grabežljivcem u Južnoj Americi. Suše i požari prijete Pantanalu, ali velika su prijetnja i prekomjerne poplave. Simon će razgovarati s farmerom koji je proveo godine gradeći brane ne bi li zaustavio vodene bujice i zaštitio obiteljsku farmu. Tijekom zadnje etape ovog putovanja Simon odlazi u rijetko posjećivani Paragvaj u kojem će zateći jedinstvenu zajednicu koja, unatoč tome što je malobrojna, ima velik utjecaj na gospodarstvo i ekologiju ove zemlje. Menoniti izvorno potječu iz Europe, ali raselili su se diljem svijeta. U Paragvaju živi osobito konzervativni ogranak koji se odrekao svih tekovina modernog doba. Oni voze kola s konjima i govore svojim jezikom poznatim kako donjonjemački. Simon će posjetiti školu u kojoj djeca u tradicionalnim nošnjama uče biblijske tekstove, a na vidiku nema nijednog pametnog telefona. Međutim, Menoniti su vrlo uspješni farmeri i prihvaćaju moderne metode uzgoja kada je to potrebno te osnivaju prostrane farme za uzgoj stoke i soje. Oni su raskrčili golema prostranstva jedinstvene suhe šume Chaco koja se prostire na području veličine dvije Španjolske te dominira sredinom južnoameričkog kontinenta. Ovo je gospodarsko čudo podiglo Paragvaj na sam vrh svjetskih proizvođača hrane, ali možda je i to neizbježno imalo svoju cijenu. Simon ovu etapu putovanja zaključuje posjetom narodu Ayoreo. R.:...

programme.title: Sokol's eyes / Oči sokolove
programme.desc: Falcon eyes - (E06, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) The island of Pag. The unique island in the heart of Dalmatia is known for its harsh beauty, rich history and cultural heritage. Due to the storm worn with a resort, the surface of the whole Pag is irresistibly reminiscent of the surface of Mars, and Legend says that the ancient goddess Athens was on the island. On the island, we will get acquainted with the production of Pag lace, which is listed on the UNESCO list of the intangible heritage of humanity. Neda Oros will be told about the tradition of lace. The drone will also fly the north of the island of Pag, which also has gardens of centuries -old Luna olives. The wild olives are a symbol of resistance to storms and stone, and in one such corner of the Mediterranean there is a olive tree over 2000 years. In the midst of summer, the drone shots will also show the harvesting of a salt flower in the fields of Pag Solana. On the island of Pag, miles and kilometers of long drywall, the eternal monument of the heavy life of Pag aspiration, can be found, high enough that the Pag sheep cannot skip them. We will also follow the Ovcar Shepherd in the early morning tour of our herd. Pag is also rich in numerous archeological sites from various periods, among which the sites of ancient times are particularly emphasized. Air recordings will be accompanied by a group of underwater archaeologists that will clean an ancient ship from the 1st century BC in the area of ​​the Archaeological site near Simon. For the first time, testify to the performance of the Pag Tanca seen from the air. This dance, characteristic of its unique male and female costumes, reflects the tradition of this Adriatic jewel and the pride of all its inhabitants. The drone will also take us to the northeast coast of the Gulf of Pag, in a metajno, where we will see from the air what a trail looks like on the Mars field. That the bridges have always merged and that the symbols of the connections are, we will also be convinced by the air recordings of the Pag Bridge. This magnificent bow in the early morning with the sunrise will be reminded of the viewers to stop for a moment and see for a moment of unique beauty of this construction miracle. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Oči sokolove - (E06, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Otok Pag. Jedinstveni otok u srcu Dalmacije poznat je po svojoj surovoj ljepoti, bogatoj povijesti i kulturnoj baštini. Zbog bure nošene posolicom, površina cijelog Paga neodoljivo podsjeća na površinu Marsa, a legenda kaže kako je na otoku stolovala i antička božica Atena. Na otoku ćemo se upoznati s izradom paške čipke koja je uvrštena na Unescovu listu nematerijalne baštine čovječanstva. O tradiciji čipkarstva govorit će nam Neda Oros. Dron će preletjeti i sjever otoka Paga, na kojemu se nalaze i vrtovi stoljetnih lunskih maslina. Samonikle masline simbol su otpora prema buri i kamenu, a u jednom takvom kutku Mediterana smjestilo se i stablo masline staro više od 2000 godina. U jeku ljeta, snimke dronom prikazat će i berbu cvijeta soli na poljima paške solane. Na otoku Pagu mogu se pronaći kilometri i kilometri dugih suhozida, vječni spomenik teškog života paškog težaka, dovoljno visoki da ih paška ovca ne može preskočiti. Pratit ćemo i paškog ovčara u ranojutarnjem obilasku svojeg stada. Pag obiluje i mnogobrojnim arheološkim nalazištima iz raznih razdoblja, među kojima se posebno ističu nalazišta iz antičkog doba. Zračne snimke pratit će skupinu podvodnih arheologa koji će na području arheološkog nalazišta Letavica u blizini Šimuna čistiti antički brod iz 1. stoljeća prije Krista. Po prvi put posvjedočite i izvođenju paškog tanca viđenog iz zraka. Ovaj ples, karakterističan po svojim unikatnim muškim i ženskim nošnjama, odražava tradiciju ovog jadranskog dragulja i ponos svih njegovih stanovnika. Dron će nas odvesti i na sjeveroistočne obale Paškog zaljeva, u Metajnu, gdje ćemo iz zraka vidjeti kako izgleda trail na marsovskom terenu. Da mostovi oduvijek spajaju i da su simboli povezivanja, uvjerit ćemo se i zračnim snimkama Paškog mosta. Taj velebni luk u rano jutro s izlaskom Sunca gledatelje će podsjetiti da na trenutak zastanu i uvjere se u jedinstvenu ljepotu ovog graditeljskog čuda. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.desc: Agatha Christies Markle - (S06, E02, Crimea. Series, England, 2014) When Louisa Oxley, an old family friend in trouble, fleeing Mrs. Markle's stormy night, our amateur detective knows that Louisi and her young son Archie must help and find them shelter in the nearby Greenshaw Folly. Miss Markle oblives Louisa to get a job of secretary Nu Folly, a chaotic village estate of a dear friend Miss Markle, an eccentric botanist Katherine Greenshaw, the last in a long family lineage. But even though Louis accelerated two fans - gardener Alfred and actor Nata - it soon becomes clear that Folly's maze is not a refuge that Miss Markle Nadal. Soon death begins to throw its dark and sinister shadow - first at Walter Cracken, a loyal family butter whose death seems to be an unhappy case after a glass of drinks too ... but the wise Miss Markle is not ready to believe it as Inspector Welch. And when Folly Horace Bindler's guest disappears, it seems that a dangerous storm is being prepared, which finally reaches the dramatic peak in the bloody murder of Miss Greenshaw. Everyone is suspicious, but no one can imagine the secrets - both the present and the former - which will be discovered by Miss Mardle ... R .: Sarah Harding Ul.: Julia McKenzie (Miss Markle), Kimberley Nixon (Louisa Oxley), Bobby Smalldridge (Archie Oxley), Martin Compston (Alfred Pollock) Cracken) ... / Agatha Christies Marple - (S06, E02, krim. serija, Engleska, 2014) Kad Louisa Oxley, stara obiteljska prijateljica u nevolji, bježeći posjeti gospođicu Marple jedne olujne noći, naša amaterska detektivka zna da mora pomoći i Louisi i njezinu mladom sinu Archieju, te im nalazi zaklon u obližnjem Greenshaws Follyju. Gospođica Marple isposluje da Louisa dobije posao tajnice nu Follyju, kaotičnom seoskom imanju drage prijateljice gospođice Marple, ekscentrične botaničarke Katherine Greenshaw, zadnje u dugoj obiteljskoj lozi. programme.title: South America Simon Reeve / Južna Amerika sa Simonom Reeveom
programme.desc: Simon Reeves South America - (E04, Nature. Film, England, 2022) Simon Reeve travels through three most extreme landscapes on Earth: salty plains in Bolivia, Brazilian Panthanal and Chaco Forest in Paraguay. In Bolivia, Simon meets with a family who lives on the collection of salt on the vast expanse of salty plains Uyuni, who are so huge that they are allegedly visible from the moon. They will find out that there may be huge lithium deposits under the salt, a metal that is key to making batteries, especially those for a new generation of electric cars. Crossing in Brazil, Simon visits one of the biggest swamps - Pantanal and will experience a close encounter with Jaguar, the greatest predator in South America. Dries and fires threaten to panthanale, but there are a large threat and excessive flood. Simon will talk to a farmer who spent years building dams to stop water torrents and protect the family farm. During the last stage of this trip, Simon goes to the rarely visited Paraguay, in which he will find a unique community, which, despite being a small, has a great impact on the economy and ecology of this country. Menonites originally come from Europe, but they have moved around the world. Paraguay lives a particularly conservative branch that has renounced all the flow of modern times. They drive the cars with horses and speak their language known as the lower German. Simon will visit a school where children learn biblical texts in traditional costumes, and there is no smartphone in sight. However, menonites are very successful farmers and accept modern growing methods when needed and established spacious farms for cattle and soybeans. They intersected the vast expanses of the unique dry forest of Chaco, which extends in the area of ​​two Spanish and dominates the mid -South American continent. This economic miracle raised Paraguay to the very top of the world's food producers, but maybe that inevitably had its price. Simon concludes this stage of travel by a visit to the Ayoreo people. R.: ... / Simon Reeves South America - (E04, prirod. film, Engleska, 2022) Simon Reeve putuje kroz tri najekstremnija krajolika na Zemlji: slane ravnice u Boliviji, brazilski Pantanal i šumu Chaco u Paragvaju. U Boliviji Simon se susreće s obitelji koja živi od skupljanja soli na golemom prostranstvu slanih ravnica Uyuni koje su tako goleme da su navodno vidljive i s Mjeseca. Saznat će da se ispod soli možda kriju goleme naslage litija, metala koji je ključan za izradu baterija, osobito onih za novu generaciju električnih automobila. Prešavši u Brazil, Simon posjećuje jednu od najvećih močvara - Pantanal te će doživjeti bliski susret s jaguarom, najvećim grabežljivcem u Južnoj Americi. Suše i požari prijete Pantanalu, ali velika su prijetnja i prekomjerne poplave. Simon će razgovarati s farmerom koji je proveo godine gradeći brane ne bi li zaustavio vodene bujice i zaštitio obiteljsku farmu. Tijekom zadnje etape ovog putovanja Simon odlazi u rijetko posjećivani Paragvaj u kojem će zateći jedinstvenu zajednicu koja, unatoč tome što je malobrojna, ima velik utjecaj na gospodarstvo i ekologiju ove zemlje. Menoniti izvorno potječu iz Europe, ali raselili su se diljem svijeta. U Paragvaju živi osobito konzervativni ogranak koji se odrekao svih tekovina modernog doba. Oni voze kola s konjima i govore svojim jezikom poznatim kako donjonjemački. Simon će posjetiti školu u kojoj djeca u tradicionalnim nošnjama uče biblijske tekstove, a na vidiku nema nijednog pametnog telefona. Međutim, Menoniti su vrlo uspješni farmeri i prihvaćaju moderne metode uzgoja kada je to potrebno te osnivaju prostrane farme za uzgoj stoke i soje. Oni su raskrčili golema prostranstva jedinstvene suhe šume Chaco koja se prostire na području veličine dvije Španjolske te dominira sredinom južnoameričkog kontinenta. Ovo je gospodarsko čudo podiglo Paragvaj na sam vrh svjetskih proizvođača hrane, ali možda je i to neizbježno imalo svoju cijenu. Simon ovu etapu putovanja zaključuje posjetom narodu Ayoreo. R.:...

The body shape is trying to break through various patterns, so masking the objects from the environment and finally the highlight - mimicry. A complete imitation of another kind, uninteresting and perhaps dangerous to your hunter. The submarine is many examples of top camouflage that land animals have not yet reached. A nakon nje došlo je do eksplozije ideja u kamufliranju. Oblik tijela pokušava se razbiti raznim šarama, pa maskiranjem predmetima iz okoliša i na kraju vrhunac - mimikrija. programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje

In order to know the light, nature created a fantastic organ - an eye, and to fool it again, she created camouflage. The first hunters hunted prey thanks to the recognition of shapes, movements, colors. Therefore, perhaps the first strategy in the hide -friender game was a conceal color. The color you have to merge with the environment. And after her there was an explosion of camouflage ideas. The body shape is trying to break through various patterns, so masking the objects from the environment and finally the highlight - mimicry. A complete imitation of another kind, uninteresting and perhaps dangerous to your hunter. The submarine is many examples of top camouflage that land animals have not yet reached. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S06, E02, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Iz dana u dan živi svijet podmorja, kao i nadmorja, rješava samo jedno pitanje. Kako preživjeti? Kako se prehraniti, a ne postati hrana? Priroda je izumila razne tehnike, no najprofinjenije su bile one koje bi mogli nazvati igra skrivača. I opet je svjetlo imalo odlučujuću ulogu. Da bi se spoznalo svjetlo, priroda je stvorila fantastičan organ - oko, a da bi ga opet zavaralo, stvorila je kamufliranje. Prvi lovci lovili su plijen zahvaljujući prepoznavanju oblika, kretnji, boja. Stoga je možda prva strategija u igri skrivača bila prikrivna boja. Boja s kojom se morate stopiti s okolinom. A nakon nje došlo je do eksplozije ideja u kamufliranju. Oblik tijela pokušava se razbiti raznim šarama, pa maskiranjem predmetima iz okoliša i na kraju vrhunac - mimikrija. Potpuno oponašanje neke druge vrste, nezanimljive, a možda i opasne vašem lovcu. Podmorje je puno primjera vrhunske kamuflaže kakve kopnene životinje još nisu dostigle. R.: Miro Andrić...

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Classics Mundi - (Concert Film, Croatia, 2024) The concert of The Kings Singers at the Church of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary in Osor officially opened the 49th Osor Music Evenings 2024. The Kings Singers was founded in 1968, when six former students of choral singing with Kings College held a concert in Queen Echento in Queen. Hall in London. By chance, it was made up of two counter -bodies, tenor, two baritone and bass, and this unique formation was still held. For more than fifty years, the ensemble has been setting up a gold standard in singing a cappella on the world's biggest stages. He is famed by unsurpassed technique, music and versatility, arising from a rich inheritance of the group and her aspirations to revive an extraordinary series of new and unique works, collaborations and recordings. Extensive discography has brought the ensemble numerous awards, including two Grammy Awards, Emmy Award and a place in the Gramophone's famous magazines. For this festive occasion, they have prepared a program called Legacies, which celebrates the exceptional contributions to the music world over the past 500 years. On the one hand, the choral works of two of the most prominent English Renaissance composers, whose deaths have been four centuries last year, Thomas Weelkes and William Byrda, and on the other works of contemporary music by Gyorgy's League, whose provocative and avant -garde manuscript redefined the composition of the 20th century "Nonsense Madrigals". Between the Swedish romantic, Hugo Alfven, inspired by the folklore tradition of his country, and the premiere that emphasizes the important aspect of the action of The Kings Singers - "The dedication to the development of the global choir canon" - the new work of Croatian composer Blaženko Juračić Carmen de Doctrin (priority, with the 500th anniversary of the death of Marko Marulić). The program frames Close -Harmony Songs - a selection of multicolored songs performed in a tight syllable dominated by music from the "When you Wish Prosn a Star" released last year ... / Klasika mundi - (koncertni film, Hrvatska, 2024) Koncert ansambla The Kings Singers u crkvi Uznesenja Blažene Djevice Marije u Osoru svečano je otvorio 49. Osorske glazbene večeri 2024. Sastav The Kings Singers osnovan je 1968., kada je šest nekadašnjih studenata zborskog pjevanja s Kings Collegea u Cambridgeu održalo koncert u Queen Elizabeth Hallu u Londonu. Igrom slučaja, činila su ga dva kontratenora, tenor, dva baritona i bas, a ta se jedinstvena formacija održala i dalje. Ansambl već više od pedeset godina postavlja zlatni standard u pjevanju a cappella na najvećim svjetskim pozornicama. Glasovit je po nenadmašnoj tehnici, muziciranju i svestranosti, koje proizlaze iz bogatog naslijeđa grupe te njezine težnje da oživi izvanredan niz novih i jedinstvenih djela, suradnji i snimaka. Opsežna diskografija donijela je ansamblu brojna priznanja, uključujući dvije nagrade Grammy, nagradu Emmy i mjesto u Kući slavnih časopisa Gramophone. Za ovu svečanu prigodu pripremili su program nazvan Legacies, koji slavi iznimne doprinose svijetu glazbe u proteklih 500 godina. S jedne su strane zborska djela dvojice najistaknutijih engleskih renesansnih skladatelja od čije su smrti protekle godine prošla četiri stoljeća, Thomasa Weelkesa i Williama Byrda, a s druge djela velikana suvremene glazbe Gyorgyja Ligetija, čiji je provokativan i avangardan rukopis redefinirao kompoziciju 20. stoljeća i koji je upravo za sastav Kings Singers skladao "Nonsense Madrigals". Između su švedski romantičar Hugo Alfven, nadahnut folklornom tradicijom svoje zemlje, i praizvedba koja naglašava važan aspekt djelovanja ansambla The Kings Singers - "predanost razvijanju globalnog zborskog kanona" - novo djelo hrvatskog skladatelja Blaženka Juračića Carmen de doctrina (praizvedba, uz 500. godišnjicu smrti Marka Marulića). programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: Croatian submarine - (S06, E03, known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2003) The Adriatic Sea may at first glance look like a tame oasis of an immutable life. But this is a nervous system constantly exposed to new newcomers who often call the intruders because of their effect. Some intruders come to us from the neighborhood, of the Sea of ​​the Sea, naturally moving because of the warming of the sea, and some more dangerous come even from the opposite end of the world because of the carelessness and greed of man. Many become part of the natural heritage in a natural and slow way, and many in an unnatural and aggressive way destroy this heritage. Often a man is powerless in the fight with them and the only thing remains for him is to wait for the answer of nature. The intruders that nature brings us are not necessarily a bad occurrence for the ecosystem. Their arrival drives domestic species to develop, adjust and create coexistence. The intruders thus become a domestic species over time, enriching the living world. And after a few generations, we can't even imagine that there were once intruders. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S06, E03, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Jadransko more možda nekima na prvi pogled izgleda kao pitoma oaza nepromjenjivog života. Neki uljezi dolaze nam iz susjedstva, Jonskog mora, prirodno se pomičući zbog zatopljivanja mora, a neki puno opasniji dolaze čak sa suprotnog kraja svijeta zbog nepažnje i pohlepe čovjeka. Mnogi na prirodan i polagan način postaju dio prirodne baštine, a mnogi na neprirodan i agresivan način tu baštinu uništavaju. Često je čovjek nemoćan u borbi s njima i jedino što mu ostaje jest da čeka odgovor prirode. Uljezi koje nam priroda donese nisu nužno loša pojava za ekosustav. Njihov dolazak tjera domaće vrste da se razvijaju, prilagođavaju i stvore suživot. Uljezi tako vremenom postaju domaća vrsta, obogaćujući živi svijet. A nakon nekoliko generacija ne možemo ni zamisliti da su nekada bili uljezi. R.: Miro Andrić...

U međuvremenu, Mirta je napravila gnijezdo od svih svojih igračaka. Upravo se sprema udobno smjestiti na vrhu kad se Skupljač zvukova spušta u kadar, još uvijek držeći uže zmaja, slijećući sigurno na hrpu - savršeno slijetanje! Kasnije nalazimo Mirtu pokraj Skupljača zvukova ispred vatre - sada on nosi Mirtine papuče. Mirta ih opet promatra sa zanimanjem!...

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: Croatian submarine - (S06, E03, known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2003) The Adriatic Sea may at first glance look like a tame oasis of an immutable life. But this is a nervous system constantly exposed to new newcomers who often call the intruders because of their effect. Some intruders come to us from the neighborhood, of the Sea of ​​the Sea, naturally moving because of the warming of the sea, and some more dangerous come even from the opposite end of the world because of the carelessness and greed of man. Many become part of the natural heritage in a natural and slow way, and many in an unnatural and aggressive way destroy this heritage. Often a man is powerless in the fight with them and the only thing remains for him is to wait for the answer of nature. The intruders that nature brings us are not necessarily a bad occurrence for the ecosystem. Their arrival drives domestic species to develop, adjust and create coexistence. The intruders thus become a domestic species over time, enriching the living world. And after a few generations, we can't even imagine that there were once intruders. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S06, E03, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Jadransko more možda nekima na prvi pogled izgleda kao pitoma oaza nepromjenjivog života. No to je živ sustav stalno izložen novim došljacima koje često zbog njihova učinka prozovemo uljezima. Neki uljezi dolaze nam iz susjedstva, Jonskog mora, prirodno se pomičući zbog zatopljivanja mora, a neki puno opasniji dolaze čak sa suprotnog kraja svijeta zbog nepažnje i pohlepe čovjeka. Mnogi na prirodan i polagan način postaju dio prirodne baštine, a mnogi na neprirodan i agresivan način tu baštinu uništavaju. Često je čovjek nemoćan u borbi s njima i jedino što mu ostaje jest da čeka odgovor prirode. Uljezi koje nam priroda donese nisu nužno loša pojava za ekosustav. Njihov dolazak tjera domaće vrste da se razvijaju, prilagođavaju i stvore suživot. Uljezi tako vremenom postaju domaća vrsta, obogaćujući živi svijet. A nakon nekoliko generacija ne možemo ni zamisliti da su nekada bili uljezi. R.: Miro Andrić...

programme.title: Man and Space - Contemporary Croatian Architecture / Čovjek i prostor - suvremena hrvatska arhitektura
programme.desc: Man and Space - (S02, E04, Educational Program, Croatia, 2022) Viktor Kovacic's Lifetime Achievement Award in 2019 was awarded to the architect Radovan Taider. The work of the architect of Radovan Taider is only the embodiment of the timeless simplicity of the spatial conception and architectural form per se relies on the best of the Zagreb School of Architecture. Without much restraint, Taider can be appointed by the full -blooded sequel to her unadoching modernism - the character and work of Viktor Kovačić, Juraj Denzler and Mladen Kauzlaric. He is the one to whom unobtrusiveness, decency is not only the origin of professional action, but the only possible way of coating. Architect Radovan Taider was born in Zagreb in 1945. He graduated from the Faculty of Architecture, University of Zagreb in 1970 under the mentorship of Professor Drago Galić. The professional career of the designer begins at the Zagreb Didakainvest, ie Yogodicti (1971 - 1976), where he is closely specializing in architecture for pre -school education and school education and specialized institutions, with which he continues in the project bureau of the basis, where he has been working since 1977. 414. In the dynamic period of construction and equipping of new Zagreb residential settlements - Dugava, Gajnica, Prečko and Perjavica - as well as in social standard buildings, patening of type project solutions or reality systems is a challenge that Terder is not running away. While the appearance of kindergarten and the school is modernist, with the overproduction of the brutalism of tangible in the material, in the way of thinking of the task of space, their heart is shaped in the spirit of Team 10, as a place of social interaction. Tader also adorns the exceptional sensibility for construction in historical ambiences in which it creates a new, not less valuable layer with its interpolations - a layer that is contemporary, brings new value, but at the same time it is full of chickens. R .: Željko Sarić Ul.: Marinko Les (Narrator ... / Čovjek i prostor - (S02, E04, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2022) Nagrada za Životno djelo Viktor Kovačić u 2019. godini dodijeljena je arhitektu Radovanu Tajderu. Djelo arhitekta Radovana Tajdera samo je utjelovljenje bezvremene jednostavnosti prostorne koncepcije i arhitektonske forme per se koja se oslanja na ono najbolje od zagrebačke škole arhitekture. Bez puno suzdržavanja Tajdera se može imenovati punokrvnim nastavljačem njezinoga nepatvorenog modernizma - lika i djela Viktora Kovačića, Jurja Denzlera i Mladena Kauzlarića. On je taj kojemu je nenametljivost, pristojnost ne samo ishodište profesionalnog djelovanja, nego jedini mogući način supostojanja. Arhitekt Radovan Tajder rođen je u Zagrebu 1945. godine. Diplomirao je na Arhitektonskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu 1970. pod mentorstvom profesora Drage Galića. Profesionalnu karijeru projektanta počinje u zagrebačkom Didaktainvestu, tj. Yugodidacti (1971. - 1976.), gdje se usko specijalizira u arhitekturi zgrada za predškolski odgoj i školsko obrazovanje te specijaliziranih ustanova s čijom izgradnjom nastavlja i u projektnom birou Osnova gdje radi od 1977. S arhitektom Mladenom Anđelom Tajder razvija komponibilne sustave osnovnoškolskih i predškolskih ustanova Megas i 414. U dinamičnom razdoblju izgradnje i opremanja novih zagrebačkih stambenih naselja - Dugava, Gajnica, Prečkog i Perjavice - kao i u zgradama društvenog standarda, patentiranje tipskih projektnih rješenja odnosno sustava realnost je, izazov od kojega Tajder ne bježi. Dok je pojavnost vrtića i škola modernistička, s natruhom brutalizma opipljivog u materijalu, po načinu mišljenja zadaće prostora njihovo srce oblikovano je u duhu Teama 10, kao mjesta društvene interakcije. Tajdera krasi i izniman senzibilitet za građenje u povijesnim ambijentima u kojima svojim interpolacijama stvara novi, ne manje vrijedan sloj - sloj koji je suvremen, donosi novu vrijednost, ali je istovremeno pun pijeteta. programme.desc: 69. Split Summer - (entertainment program, Croatia, 2023) to the 69th anniversary of the important festival of opera, drama, music and dance whose ceremonial opening on July 14, 2023. Libreta was written by Luigi Ilica and Giuseppe Giacos according to the drama "La Tosca" Victorienna Sardou. Under the direction of Maestro Ivo Lipanovic and directed by Goran Golovk, a real love - political thriller focused on the relations between the protagonists (Tosca, Cavadossi, Scarpia) awaits us on Peristyle. The shop takes place in Rome, afternoon and evening on June 14 and early in the morning of June 15, 1800. R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / 69. Splitsko ljeto - (zabavni program, Hrvatska, 2023) Na 69. obljetnicu važnog festivala opere, drame, glazbe i plesa čije je svečano otvorenje 14. srpnja 2023. tradicionalno prenosila Hrvatska televizija, donosimo izvedbu jednog od najizvođenijih djela svjetske operne literature - operu Tosca talijanskog skladatelja Giuseppea Verdija. Libreto su napisali Luigi Ilica i Giuseppe Giacosa prema drami " La Tosca" Victoriena Sardoua. Pod ravnanjem maestra Ive Lipanovića i u režiji Gorana Golovka, na Peristilu nas čeka pravi ljubavno - politički triler usredotočen na odnose protagonista (Tosca, Cavaradossi, Scarpia). Radnja se odvija u Rimu, poslijepodne i navečer 14. lipnja te rano ujutro 15. lipnja 1800. Operu prenosimo s hrvatskim titlovima! R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.title: Ties and acquaintances in paradise / Veze i poznanstva u raju
programme.desc: Ho amici in paradiso - (film, Italy, 2016) Felice Castriota is from Salenta, a city in southern Italy. Knie, is impulsive and a little superficial. The desire to enrich and certain recklessness lead him to the engagement of the money of criminal money, but soon he is arrested. When the Attorney General suggests a settlement and offers to do socially useful work instead of prison, Felice accepts it without thinking and breathes an influential gangster for which he washed the money. At Don Guanella at the Roman Center, where he was sent to work, Felice encountered a completely different reality from the one he expected and those he had known before. As a superficial man learned on luxury, he finds himself in a completely different environment, full of people with serious physical and mental damage. There are constant crises, it is necessary to change diapers, it is difficult to communicate with the protégés, and all this becomes the usual practice of his days. Little a little, thanks to the love of young psychologist Julia, Felica for the first time in his life begins to feel a member of a new great family and becomes what he has never been: man. And just as everything seemingly moves in the perfect direction, Felice suddenly meets his past and collecting old debts. He will have to face the threats of a gangster who never stopped looking for him, and now he has finally found him. R .: Fabrizio Maria Cortese Ul.: Fabrizio Ferrarane (Felice Castriota), Antonio Folletto (Antonio), Rosario Altavilla (Scagnozzo 2), Mariano Belvedere (Giacomo), Giustina Buonomo (Mariuccia) ... / Ho amici in paradiso - (film, Italija, 2016) Felice Castriota je iz Salenta, grada na jugu Italije. Knigovođa je, impulzivan i pomalo površan. Želja da se obogati i određena bezobzirnost dovode ga do angažmana pranja novca kriminalaca, no ubrzo zbog toga bude uhićen. Kad mu državni odvjetnik predloži nagodbu i ponudi da umjesto zatvora odradi društveno koristan rad, Felice to prihvati bez razmišljanja i prokaže utjecajnog gangstera za kojeg je prao novac. U rimskom centru Don Guanella, kamo je poslan na rad, Felice se susreće sa posve drukčijom stvarnošću od one koju je očekivao i one koju je dotad poznavao. Kao površan čovjek naučen na luksuz nađe se u posve drukčijem okruženju, punom ljudi s ozbiljnim tjelesnim i mentalnim oštećenjima. Tu su stalne krize, treba mijenjati pelene, teško je komunicirati sa štićenicima i sve to postaje uobičajena praksa njegovih dana. Malo pomalo, zahvaljujući i ljubavi prema mladoj psihologinji Juliji, Felice se prvi put u životu počinje osjećati članom nove velike obitelji i postaje ono što nikad nije bio: čovjek. I baš dok se sve naizgled kreće u savršenom smjeru, Felice se odjednom susretne sa svojom prošlošću i naplatom starih dugova. Morat će se suočiti s prijetnjama gangstera koji ga nikad nije prestao tražiti, a sad ga je napokon našao. R.: Fabrizio Maria Cortese Ul.: Fabrizio Ferracane (Felice Castriota), Antonio Folletto (Antonio), Rosario Altavilla (Scagnozzo 2), Mariano Belvedere (Giacomo), Giustina Buonomo (Mariuccia)...

programme.title: Man and Space - Contemporary Croatian Architecture / Čovjek i prostor - suvremena hrvatska arhitektura
programme.desc: Man and Space - (S02, E04, Educational Program, Croatia, 2022) Viktor Kovacic's Lifetime Achievement Award in 2019 was awarded to the architect Radovan Taider. The work of the architect of Radovan Taider is only the embodiment of the timeless simplicity of the spatial conception and architectural form per se relies on the best of the Zagreb School of Architecture. Without much restraint, Taider can be appointed by the full -blooded sequel to her unadoching modernism - the character and work of Viktor Kovačić, Juraj Denzler and Mladen Kauzlaric. He is the one to whom unobtrusiveness, decency is not only the origin of professional action, but the only possible way of coating. Architect Radovan Taider was born in Zagreb in 1945. He graduated from the Faculty of Architecture, University of Zagreb in 1970 under the mentorship of Professor Drago Galić. The professional career of the designer begins at the Zagreb Didakainvest, ie Yogodicti (1971 - 1976), where he is closely specializing in architecture for pre -school education and school education and specialized institutions, with which he continues in the project bureau of the basis, where he has been working since 1977. 414. In the dynamic period of construction and equipping of new Zagreb residential settlements - Dugava, Gajnica, Prečko and Perjavica - as well as in social standard buildings, patening of type project solutions or reality systems is a challenge that Terder is not running away. While the appearance of kindergarten and the school is modernist, with the overproduction of the brutalism of tangible in the material, in the way of thinking of the task of space, their heart is shaped in the spirit of Team 10, as a place of social interaction. Tader also adorns the exceptional sensibility for construction in historical ambiences in which it creates a new, not less valuable layer with its interpolations - a layer that is contemporary, brings new value, but at the same time it is full of chickens. R .: Željko Sarić Ul.: Marinko Les (Narrator ... / Čovjek i prostor - (S02, E04, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2022) Nagrada za Životno djelo Viktor Kovačić u 2019. godini dodijeljena je arhitektu Radovanu Tajderu. Djelo arhitekta Radovana Tajdera samo je utjelovljenje bezvremene jednostavnosti prostorne koncepcije i arhitektonske forme per se koja se oslanja na ono najbolje od zagrebačke škole arhitekture. Bez puno suzdržavanja Tajdera se može imenovati punokrvnim nastavljačem njezinoga nepatvorenog modernizma - lika i djela Viktora Kovačića, Jurja Denzlera i Mladena Kauzlarića. On je taj kojemu je nenametljivost, pristojnost ne samo ishodište profesionalnog djelovanja, nego jedini mogući način supostojanja. Arhitekt Radovan Tajder rođen je u Zagrebu 1945. godine. Diplomirao je na Arhitektonskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu 1970. pod mentorstvom profesora Drage Galića. Profesionalnu karijeru projektanta počinje u zagrebačkom Didaktainvestu, tj. Yugodidacti (1971. - 1976.), gdje se usko specijalizira u arhitekturi zgrada za predškolski odgoj i školsko obrazovanje te specijaliziranih ustanova s čijom izgradnjom nastavlja i u projektnom birou Osnova gdje radi od 1977. S arhitektom Mladenom Anđelom Tajder razvija komponibilne sustave osnovnoškolskih i predškolskih ustanova Megas i 414. U dinamičnom razdoblju izgradnje i opremanja novih zagrebačkih stambenih naselja - Dugava, Gajnica, Prečkog i Perjavice - kao i u zgradama društvenog standarda, patentiranje tipskih projektnih rješenja odnosno sustava realnost je, izazov od kojega Tajder ne bježi. Dok je pojavnost vrtića i škola modernistička, s natruhom brutalizma opipljivog u materijalu, po načinu mišljenja zadaće prostora njihovo srce oblikovano je u duhu Teama 10, kao mjesta društvene interakcije. Tajdera krasi i izniman senzibilitet za građenje u povijesnim ambijentima u kojima svojim interpolacijama stvara novi, ne manje vrijedan sloj - sloj koji je suvremen, donosi novu vrijednost, ali je istovremeno pun pijeteta.
